newsitem.title: UK: Britain names new ambassador to Washington.
newsitem.headline: Britain names new ambassador to Washington.

text.p: Britain on Thursday named Christopher Meyer to be its next ambassador in Washington in succession to Sir John Kerr, who is returning to London to head the diplomatic service.
Meyer, a career diplomat who served for two years as press spokesman to former prime minister John Major, will take up his post in October after spending just a few months as ambassador in Bonn.
He will be succeeded as ambassador to Germany by Paul Lever, another career diplomat who has worked since 1994 as the head of the Cabinet Office's overseas and defence secretariat.
Foreign Office officials denied that pulling Meyer out of Bonn so abruptly was a snub to Germany.
They said Kerr's promotion had forced the government to juggle a number of top diplomatic appointments. "These things sometimes happen," one official said.
